---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(here)
library(flexdashboard)

nhanes_data <- import(here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"))
```


```{r create-average-sbp}
nhanes_data <- nhanes_data %>%
  mutate(
    average_sbp = rowMeans(
      select(
        .,
        systolic_bp_1,
        systolic_bp_2,
        systolic_bp_3,
        systolic_bp_4
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    average_sbp = ifelse(
      is.nan(average_sbp),
      NA,
      average_sbp
    )
  )
```


Row {data-height=650}
-------------------------------------

### NHANES Sample

```{r sample-plot, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(nhanes_data, aes(x = age, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 5,
    boundary = 15,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution of the NHANES Sample",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


Row {data-height=350}
-------------------------------------

### Percentage Aged 21 or Older

```{r age-gauge}
percentage_21_plus <- mean(
  nhanes_data$age >= 21,
  na.rm = TRUE
) * 100

gauge(
  value = percentage_21_plus,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    success = c(80, 100),
    warning = c(50, 80),
    danger = c(0, 50)
  )
)
```

### Average Systolic Blood Pressure Above 120 mm Hg

```{r sbp-value}
percentage_sbp_above_120 <- mean(
  nhanes_data$average_sbp > 120,
  na.rm = TRUE
) * 100

valueBox(
  value = paste0(round(percentage_sbp_above_120, 1), "%"),
  caption = "Participants with average systolic BP > 120 mm Hg",
  color = "blue"
)
```
